name: JavDB v3
notes: Stable-derived Local-First delivery candidate. Business/API/UI/account/official playback baseline remains Stable 3.9.42. First launch installs immutable Entry/Builder and generates one local Runtime bundle containing the seven Core fragments, nine Custom fragments, exact Stable patch chain and localized Shared JAV Playback SDK. Later normal startup uses local Entry + one require(file://) Runtime bundle and does not load Remote Manager/Bootstrap/GitHub code. Shared playback lazyRule/select callbacks re-enter the local javdb3 module. Stable/Latest are unchanged until device validation.
